_about: All text of the AI Gigafactory demo. Edit the values only. *text* is italic, [text](url) is a link, {name} is filled in by the page.
hud.title: AI Gigafactory
hero.title: The AI *Giga*factory
hero.text: Where electricity, water and silicon are turned into intelligence. Scroll to take the tour, from the grid connection down to a single chip.
campus.title: A power plant in reverse
campus.text: Hundreds of megawatts flow in from the grid. What leaves is heat, and tokens. Data halls, a substation, cooling yards and a solar field, sized for on the order of a hundred thousand accelerators.
cooling.title: Every watt becomes heat
cooling.text: Practically all the power a GPU draws ends up as heat. AI racks now draw well over 100 kW each, far more than air can carry away. So the coolant goes straight to the chips.
cooling.stat1.label: Rack density
cooling.stat2.label: Heat carried by
cooling.stat3.label: Typical PUE
hall.title: Hundreds of racks, one machine
hall.text: This hall holds 560 racks. During training they behave like a single computer, and every GPU waits for every other one at each step.
rack.title: One rack, 72 GPUs
rack.text: Current flagship racks wire 72 GPUs into one shared memory domain. Each weighs well over a tonne and draws as much power as a few hundred homes.
lightsOut.title: Switch off the daylight
lightsOut.text: …and you see what actually moves: electrons, heat and data. From here on, everything that carries a signal glows.
silicon.title: Two dies, eight memory stacks
silicon.text: One GPU package: two compute dies stitched together, flanked by stacks of high-bandwidth memory. Roughly 200 billion transistors, all doing one thing extremely fast: multiplying matrices.
network.title: Thousands of GPUs, one computer
network.text: Every rack connects to a leaf switch, and every leaf to the spine above it. After each training step, every GPU shares what it has learned with all the others. The network is as critical as the chips.
network.stat1.label: Inside a rack
network.stat2.label: Between racks
training.title: Weeks in lockstep
training.text: Compute, then share. Compute, then share. Millions of times, while the loss, the model's error, slowly falls. One broken GPU stalls everyone.
training.hint.mouse: Click any rack to make it fail.
training.hint.touch: Tap any rack to make it fail.
training.status.stall: Rack {rack} failed · the other 559 racks wait
training.status.rewind: Restoring the last checkpoint · {lost} steps of work lost
training.status.resume: Resumed · spare rack swapped in for {rack}
output.title: Tokens out to the world
output.text: Everything in the building exists for this: a stream of tokens leaving Luxembourg at the speed of light, answering questions a continent away.
credits.title: Built by Andreas Braun
credits.text: An experiment in explaining infrastructure through scroll and light. [More demos](https://andreasbraun.lu/demos/)
